name: One Hour Cinnamon Rolls
description: Nutrition values are estimates per roll (not from the recipe), assuming 5½ cups bread flour, salted butter, table salt, packed brown sugar and all of the frosting used.
keywords: cinnamon rolls, breakfast, baking, sweet rolls
recipeIngredient: 3 tablespoons butter, melted, for the filling
⅔ cup brown sugar, for the filling
⅔ cup sugar, for the filling
¼ cup butter, softened, for the frosting
3 cups powdered sugar, for the frosting
4 oz cream cheese, softened, for the frosting
Milk or half and half, enough to make it spreading consistency, for the frosting

recipeInstructions.text: In a bowl mix together water, buttermilk, sugar, melted butter and yeast. Allow to sit for 15 minutes.
Add in salt, eggs and flour. Mix for 10 minutes and allow to sit for 10 minutes.
Prepare your filling by mixing together melted butter, brown sugar, sugar and cinnamon. Set aside.
On a floured surface, roll dough into a 12x16 inch square. Spread your filling over the top and roll up. Cut into 12 large rolls.
Place rolls on a cookie sheet covered with a silpat or parchment paper. Bake at 375 for 15-20 minutes.
While baking, mix together your frosting ingredients. Spread on warm rolls and serve.
